mapper.insert: INSERT INTO stock_movements (variant_id, movement_type, delta, qty_before, qty_after, ref_type, ref_id, note) VALUES (#{variantId}, #{movementType}, #{delta}, #{qtyBefore}, #{qtyAfter}, #{refType}, #{refId}, #{note})
mapper.select: SELECT id, movement_type AS movementType, delta, qty_before AS qtyBefore, qty_after AS qtyAfter, ref_type AS refType, ref_id AS refId, note, created_at AS createdAt FROM stock_movements WHERE variant_id = #{variantId} ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
